name: ado-lens
description: Work items, sprints, boards, wiki, Git and TFVC of Azure DevOps for Claude - compact answers, few tokens.
long_description: ADO Lens answers what a Product Owner or developer asks about Azure DevOps: work items with their acceptance criteria, sprints and boards, the wiki, whether a work item was done as asked and where it is deployed (DEV / UAT / PROD), how a feature works, pull requests and pipelines. Answers are compact text instead of raw JSON. This extension covers Claude Desktop only; the full installer also sets up Claude Code and the skills.

organization.title: Organization or project link
organization.description: A link to your project from the browser (https://dev.azure.com/contoso/Sales) or the organization name. Leave empty when ADO Lens is already signed in on this computer (adolens login).

project.title: Project
project.description: Default project; not needed when the link has it.

pat.title: Personal access token
pat.description: Azure DevOps: your picture > Personal access tokens > New Token (Work Items, Code, Wiki, Build, Release, Test Management, Project and Team, Identity). Claude Desktop keeps it in the system's secure storage.

mode.title: Who uses it
mode.description: po (Product Owner, analyst), dev (developer) or full - only which tools Claude sees.
